blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Around 300 protesters were detained by police following a protest march in Muntinlupa City on Sunday, according to progressive groups. Lucky Oralleo, spokesperson of Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) – Timog Katagalugan, said police dispersed the protesters as they were preparing to march to Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila to join a larger rally against Pax Silica and US President Donald Trump’s visit for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit. Oralleo, who was among those detained, accused police of blocking members of the delegation from leaving People’s Park, where they had been staying ahead of the march. […]...
